findings.title: Recurring integrity FAIL: expansion-tracker next_id == max EXP id (8 consecutive days); root cause = analyst-baby does not advance next_id on EXP write
evidence: integrity report 2026-06-17T01-17 checks.expansion_tracker.status=fail: next_id=638 equals max_id=638 (EXP-638 exists, integrated:true). Next allocation will produce duplicate EXP-638.

Recurrence: expansion_tracker check flagged [NEXT_ID] every day 06-10..-17 = warn,warn,FAIL,warn,warn,pass,FAIL,FAIL. The 06-15 pass was an Opus-analyst/decider allocation that clamped next_id past max; re-broke within a day.
Live (git HEAD): next_id=638, max live EXP id=638 (EXP-638), 0 duplicate EXP ids across 79 items — PROP-100 read-side clamp holding, NO actual corruption.

Offending write path: EXP-638 source=analyst-baby-batch, authored_by=analyst-baby, created_at=2026-06-16T04:25Z. analyst-baby.md mentions next_id ZERO times; Mode 1 BAU Step 5 writes EXP-<NNN> with no allocate-from-next_id block and no t.next_id++. By contrast analyst-normal-analysis.md L107-135 and decider.md ~L356 allocate from t.next_id with the PROP-100 archive-aware clamp then increment.
findings.root_cause: analyst-baby has no shared EXP-id allocation block; the model mints an EXP id but never advances next_id in lockstep with its own write, leaving next_id == maxid. PROP-100's clamp is a READ-side self-heal that repairs at the NEXT allocation, so corruption is prevented but the stale state trips integrity's next_id<=maxid check every morning until some other agent allocates.
findings.disposition: ALREADY CAPTURED by PROP-106 (allocate-exp-ids.js + lint-exp-allocations.js + analyst-baby.md wiring + push-time invariant lint, mirroring PROP-089 for the ISS surface). PROP-106 status=proposed, priority=medium, authored 2026-06-16T15:56 by prior tinker run. No new PROP authored — would be a strict duplicate.
new_evidence_beyond_PROP-106: PROP-106 evidence runs through 2026-06-16T03:37 (EXP-631..637 self-heal). This run adds: EXP-638 (analyst-baby, 2026-06-16T04:25) re-introduced next_id==maxid AFTER PROP-106 was authored, and integrity FAILed again on 06-16 and 06-17 — bug still actively producing daily FAILs; PROP-106 not implemented.
Impact: alert-fatigue + decider churn — every FAIL is a tracked_under:null integrity finding the decider must promote to an ISS then close on self-heal.
findings.recommendation: Operator: prioritize PROP-106 (consider bumping priority medium->medium-high given 8-day FAIL streak and recurrence-after-authoring). Correct single fix; no competing proposal needed.
